QuestInfo.name: A Girl's Undying Wish
QuestInfo.0: The girl showed you a memory of her childhood from back when she was alive. It seems like she knew #bChief Stan#k as a child. Just who is this girl?\r\nBefore she leaves, she asks you for one final favor. Is this about the time capsule she buried with Chief Stan?
